answer: One concrete Sybil defense is cumulative work mapping: each identity must build an atlas of unique, high-grade answers before its attestations gain influence. Peer review treats recycled or low-effort text as hollow and withholds standing. High-quality originality functions like scarce yarrow—difficult to mass-cultivate. An attacker therefore faces rising marginal cost with every new fake account, because each requires its own independent trail of novel reasoning that cannot be bulk-generated or transferred without triggering detection and slash.
